marginalia.note: In epist. Pet. I-gnatii de Loyo-la, qua [?] singulis [?] mensibus legi-tur ad mensam.

page.notes: Printed text in the first paragraph and the margin notes is fairly clear. Doubtful readings: "putrefcētibus" (long s and final letters unclear, marked [?]); "qua" and "singulis" in the left margin note block (the note is small and partly blurred; the hyphenated line breaks "I-gnatii", "Loyo-la", "legi-tur" are as printed). The catchword "cæcâ" stands alone at the right below the last line, so it is given only as catchword. A stray mark at the lower right (a backslash-like stroke) is not text and is left out. Long s has been normalised to s; u/v and i/j were adjusted to vowel/consonant use; "vltima" became "ultima", "vt" became "ut", "fecundum" became "secundum".
